items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: a lot of my records, I featured Bobby Johnson... They played too.

ctx.x: Now, it's very unusual to hear you say anything about not liking a particular person. (Inaudible).

I have been that way all my life as far as I can remember back. If I believe in a person, I think if he has some- thing there he should have just as much chance as I have if I can do it, like all the fellows in my band.

Like, when I got to New York, certain people said that I should be taking this solo. I should do it, I was bringing in Dud Bascomb and the other trumpet players in the band. I said no, let them take one too. Let them play. If they can play a solo, whoever it is, let them feature.
